Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
  
 Want to take a challenge to shape a new world of communications?
 Join Ericsson's Purpose Build RAN Layer 1 Software organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks.
 We are looking for SW Engineers who want to work with us to increase our customers’ satisfaction with 5G Baseband SW as well as to develop a new 6G RAN technology. Here you get opportunity to work alongside experience developers to learn how Ericsson system is designed, implemented, tested and integrated.
 This is a great opportunity for those of you who are eager to learn, adaptable, like solving technical problems and really enjoy collaborating.
  
 What you will do:
  
 •    Develop and maintain Ericsson's Purpose Build RAN Layer 1 Baseband software•    Develop a new generation of RAN SW (6G)•    Use AI-assisted engineering tools to support your activities like developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review•    Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work•    Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities•    Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams•    Work with software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement•    Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product•    Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience
  
 The skills you bring:
  
 •    A recently completed, or soon to be completed, BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related discipline•    Programming experience in C/C++, Python•    Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts•    Practical experience using Python for data processing, experimentation, or machine learning through university coursework, thesis work, or personal projects•    Ability to use AI-assisted development tools critically and responsibly•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills•    Interest in software engineering, high-performance systems, and telecommunications•    Good communication skills in English

ABOUT COGNIZANT
Cognizant is a leading global technology and professional services company that drives digital transformation for enterprises worldwide. We combine deep industry expertise, advanced technology capabilities, and human-centered design to solve complex business challenges. We're proud to partner with Google on mission-critical projects like Google Maps, where accuracy and attention to detail directly impact millions of users globally.

THE ROLE
Are you detail-oriented with a passion for geographic accuracy? Join our team as a Locality Expert, where you'll verify and validate Maps Data to ensure it reflects real-world changes. You'll audit critical geographic attributes—locations, names, platforms, entrances, exits, and transit positions across different transportation modes—by comparing them against trustworthy sources via web research. Your work ensures millions of users have accurate, real-time geographic information.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Audit Maps Data against real-world conditions and trustworthy sources to verify accuracy. You'll evaluate and update critical geographic attributes, work independently while managing your performance metrics, and meet defined SLA/TAT timelines. You'll also identify opportunities for improvement and communicate insights to your team lead, contributing to continuous quality enhancement.

WHO YOU ARE
Experience / Skills
● 3+ years of experience in the automotive industry or Urban planning, Traffics/ Transit/ Signals/ Signages
● Strong understanding of market research methodologies and techniques.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Local language and in English
● Native / Bilingual (B2+) in Swedish language
● Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
● Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
● Excellent time management and organizational skills.
● Strong analytical, excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
Nice-to-have skills include experience with vector data analysis, basic GIS map component knowledge, and PL/SQL basics.

WHY JOIN US?
Make global impact every day—your work directly influences how millions of people navigate the world. You'll develop specialized expertise in geospatial data quality within a team dedicated to excellence. Join Cognizant and grow with a global technology leader offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Become a specialist in a rapidly growing field of data quality assurance.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are seeking an experienced Function Architect for an automotive assignment in Södertälje, Sweden.
What You Will Work On
Support vehicle software and functional changes from initial concept through to agreed system solutions.
Collaborate with internal customers, system owners, architects, and impacted stakeholders.
Facilitate workshops and discussions to identify changes, dependencies, system impacts, and affected functions.
Define and document system concepts, architectural principles, interfaces, messages, and functional behaviour.
Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Document approved solutions and architectural decisions using the relevant architecture toolchain.
Support system-level decisions by evaluating impacts, dependencies, and trade-offs across the vehicle platform.
Promote flow-oriented development and effective collaboration across teams.

What You Bring
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Solid experience in function development, system development, or system ownership within embedded systems and/or automotive environments.
Good understanding of vehicle architectures, system platforms, and interconnected system dependencies.
Experience with system requirements, functional decomposition, and system concepts.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious
Previous experience working with the client.
Experience as a Function Architect, System Architect, or in a similar cross-functional architecture role.
Knowledge of automotive communication technologies such as CAN and Ethernet.
Experience with Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, or agile embedded software development.
Experience with Software Defined Vehicles (SDV), autonomous vehicles, or advanced vehicle control systems.
Familiarity with architecture toolchains and model-based development methods.

jobs.occupation: Senior Test Lead  Quality Assurance & Test Management - 20099
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Senior Test Lead to take overall responsibility for testing activities within a large-scale IT programme. You will define and drive the test strategy, coordinate testing teams, and ensure that testing is aligned with technical requirements and business objectives throughout the project lifecycle.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, agile team leads, and internal and external delivery teams to ensure effective test planning, execution, risk management, and quality reporting.
What You Will Work On
Define and maintain the overall test strategy and test plan.
Establish testing scope, objectives, deliverables, test data, and environment requirements.
Lead and coordinate testing activities and test execution across teams.
Monitor test progress, defects, and quality metrics.
Identify testing risks and define appropriate mitigation actions.
Communicate test status, issues, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
Coordinate QA, business, and delivery teams to ensure testing meets business and technical needs.
Maintain test plans, test cases, test results, and defect reports.
Support testing practices in Agile and DevOps environments.
Work with CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks.

What You Bring
Proven experience as a Test Lead in large and complex IT programmes.
Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence.
Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools, and best practices.
Experience leading teams and coordinating end-to-end testing activities.
Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
Good understanding of CI/CD processes and test automation frameworks.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience with AWS services.
Experience with test case management tools.
Experience with JMeter or similar performance testing tools.
Experience in large-scale and complex technology environments.
ISTQB Certified Test Manager or equivalent certification.

We seek a Wireless Algorithm Engineer with a strong background in AI research to join the Huawei R&D Wireless Algorithm Lab in Stockholm.
The lab conducts advanced research on wireless algorithms for 5G-Advanced products and future 6G communication systems. By deeply integrating artificial intelligence with wireless communications, they aim to explore intelligent algorithms, data-driven approaches, and AI-native technologies for next-generation wireless systems, and to drive promising research outcomes toward practical systems and products.
The successful candidate should have received systematic academic training in machine learning, deep learning, or related areas, and should be capable of independently conducting cutting-edge AI research.
Responsibilities
Research and develop innovative AI/ML algorithms and models for next-generation wireless communication systems, with applications to optimisation, prediction, and decision-making.
Build and improve simulation environments, datasets, evaluation frameworks, and experimental methodologies required for algorithm research.
Track state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and wireless communications, identify promising research directions, and formulate innovative research topics.

Qualifications
· PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
· Strong academic background in AI/ML with a deep and systematic understanding of the field
Expertise in AI research areas, such as deep learning, representation learning, generative models, sequence modeling, graph learning, reinforcement learning, foundation models, transfer learning, continual learning, or other emerging machine learning technologies.
Proficiency in Python, with hands-on research experience using mainstream deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow;
Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary research and engineering teams.

Preferred Experience
A sustained track record of high-quality publications in leading AI/ML conferences or journals;
Experience applying advanced AI methods to communications, signal processing, control, or other complex engineering systems;
Industrial R&D experience with the ability to balance frontier research value with practical algorithm implementation and deployment considerations.

Different language markets: Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Dutch, French, Italian, Greek,

Job description    
We broadcast live 24/7 in over 15 languages from our state-of-the-art studios. At the heart of our 
floor operations are our Game Presenters and Game Hosts, who run the games live on camera, 
and our Shufflers, who ensure the cards are always ready to go.   

We're now looking for Game Presenters to join our team in Malta. We are looking for people who 
thrive in a fast-paced, international environment. In this role, you'll be in front of the camera leading 
live games, interacting with players from around the world, and delivering a fun, high-quality 
experience every time you go live.   

Requirements  
-Fluency in at least one of the languages above, with a strong understanding of both spoken 
and written communication   
-Fluency in English  
-A passion for delivering great customer experiences  
-Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with a live audience  
-A strong sense of responsibility and the drive to perform at your best  
-The ability to adapt to changing business needs, including shift flexibility  
-A natural entertainer, who enjoys being in the spotlight and engaging with people  

Training provided  
Two weeks paid training You will get to spend your first 2 weeks of your journey with us in our 
Evolution Academy where we will teach you game technique and all that you need to know to be 
camera-ready.  

Any assistance with accommodation/relocation  
-Relocation package including flights & accommodation for the first 15 nights in Malta (if 
applicable)  
-Dedicated Employee Experience team who will support during the relocation  
Any other benefits  
-Performance bonus of up to 1000 Euro per month  
-Free taxi service to or from your shift during nights  
-Extra pay on night shifts  
-Free gym membership  
-Private Health Insurance  
-Development and career progression opportunities  
-Company events and workshops like yoga, healthy living, mental health, communication, 
make-up etc.  

How will the interviews be held  
Interview will be held online

We run online directories where lawyers and jurists buy a place to be visible to clients: Juristkatalogen.se (lawyers and jurists) and Svenskaadvokater.se (lawyers – advokater – only) in Sweden, Juristkatalogen.no in Norway, Juristkataloget.dk in Denmark and Lakimieshakemisto.fi in Finland.
Your role
You recruit and lead a team of five sales representatives spread across the Nordics: two in Sweden, one in Norway, one in Denmark and one in Finland. You set the plan (area of law, county), follow up every week and report to the owner.
Commission (100 %)
5 % of your team's sales: new places your team sells, and renewals of customers your team brought in. Customers who sign up on their own are not included.
Until the sites open for purchases in December 2026, customers join a queue. The first payout is in January 2027.
Examples: the team sells 100 places per month → about SEK 25,000 per month to you. 150 places per month → about SEK 37,500 per month. 200 places per month → about SEK 50,000 per month. Renewals come on top from year two.
Requirements
Experience leading sales teams against measurable targets.
Fluent English and a fluent Nordic language.
The right to work in the Nordic country you live in (EU/EEA citizen or valid work permit).

Applications that do not meet the requirements will not be considered.
Targets: five sales representatives recruited by 15 November 2026. From January 2027 at least 100 places per month for the team. If targets are not met, the assignment ends.
Terms: 100 % commission, no fixed salary or expenses. Remote.
Apply: Send a cover letter (maximum 200 words, no CV) to info@eleganceab.se, including how you will recruit five sales representatives and the date they will begin selling. Confirm that you accept the terms: 100% commission, sales targets, and contract termination if targets are not met. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
